functional_requirements.statement: An authenticated user shall create a support ticket.
An authenticated user shall list only their own support tickets.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The ticket API shall remain available when one application instance fails.
Ticket creation shall document invalid-input and temporary-service-failure responses.
The design shall support the project's approved retention policy by deleting closed tickets after 90 days and recording deletion events without ticket content.
The ticket interface shall use consistent typography, spacing, and status colors.
Ticket management, authentication, retention, and monitoring shall have separate component responsibilities.
The system shall expose health checks and record request latency, error counts, and correlation IDs without logging ticket content or credentials.
Ticket collection retrieval shall use pagination with a default of 20 and a maximum of 100 records per request.
The application shall deploy using the same OCI container image in development and production, with environment-specific settings supplied externally.
Ticket collection endpoints shall use bounded pagination as the number of tickets increases.
All ticket API operations shall require bearer authentication and restrict access to the authenticated user's own tickets.
API operations shall have readable lower-camel-case identifiers, documented parameters, and consistent error response schemas.

elements.name: Ticket Service
elements.main_responsibility: Create and list tickets. Derive owner_id from the authenticated identity; filter every ticket query by that identity. Use parameterized database queries and bounded pagination.

elements.name: Authentication Middleware
elements.main_responsibility: Validate bearer token signature, issuer, audience, and expiration before ticket operations. Supply the verified user identity; reject missing or invalid tokens with 401.

elements.name: Application Runtime
elements.main_responsibility: Run two stateless application replicas behind a load balancer. Remove failed replicas through readiness checks and route requests to healthy replicas. Deploy the same OCI image in development and production; inject database URLs and secrets externally.

elements.name: Observability Component
elements.main_responsibility: Expose readiness and liveness endpoints. Collect request latency and error counts, attach correlation IDs, and alert on unavailable replicas. Exclude ticket content, credentials, and bearer tokens from logs.

elements.name: Retention Worker
elements.main_responsibility: Run daily to delete tickets whose closed_at timestamp is older than 90 days. Record ticket identifier, deletion time, and retention-policy identifier in an audit event without retaining ticket content.

entities.name: Ticket
constraints: closed_at is required when status is closed
Index Ticket(owner_id, created_at, ticket_id) for paginated owner-filtered retrieval

responsibilities.detailed_responsibility: Create a ticket owned by the verified user; assign owner_id on the server.
List the verified user's tickets with bounded cursor pagination.

access_rules: Derive owner_id from the authenticated identity; never accept owner_id from the client.
Return only tickets owned by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Create a ticket for the authenticated user
x-access-rules: Assign owner_id from verified token identity, not client input.
Filter by verified user identity; apply stable ordering by created_at and ticket_id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response

200.description: Paginated tickets owned by the authenticated user
